id.description: Document ID (DOCUMENT_ID from the documents list)
id.title: Id

success.description: true when the document is deleted: 2xx response, or 590 followed by a confirmed absence from the documents list; on failure the action fails and returns nothing

status_code.description: HTTP status code of the DELETE (204, 200, or 590 when the deletion was confirmed by listing)

verified_by_listing.description: true when the API returned 590 and the deletion was confirmed by re-listing the documents; false for a plain 2xx

api_error.description: Error or message of the 590 body (e.g. Document was not found on the server), kept for troubleshooting; only when verified_by_listing is true
